stories.title: An innovative technology boosts image quality for protein structures
stories.summary: Nature, Published online: 12 June 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-01858-1After years of effort, two research teams have developed ‘laser phase plate’ systems that could help cryo-electron-microscopy users to generate high-quality structures for a broad range of proteins.

stories.title: Here’s How AI Agents Can Protect EV Chargers
stories.summary: An AI agent system proposed by researchers in Spain promises to prevent energy theft and damage to EV chargers, as well as the critical energy infrastructure that powers them.

stories.title: NASA-Funded Research Follows Bird Flight; Birds Follow Their Noses
stories.summary: You might think birds skimming over the ocean wouldn’t seek wind unless it was pushing them in the right direction, but NASA-funded researchers have learned that storm petrels find stiff crosswinds worth the slowdown, in return for the clues and cues the gusts carry. stories.title: Humans outperform AI at this highly rigorous mathematics test
stories.summary: Nature, Published online: 12 June 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-01888-9A new benchmark pitting AI against previously unseen maths problems shows systems still fall short of top human expertise.

stories.title: Hazard Detection Lidar System Goes to the Moon
stories.summary: Enabling landers to autonomously identify the safest sites to touch down Moon craters and their surrounding areas are high-value destinations for lunar missions since they may contain important resources and valuable science targets. However, these sites are also home to dangers such as steep slopes that are difficult to see in the challenging lighting conditions.
